locations.name: Vermont
locations.subtitle: Stowe / Killington / Mad River Valley

weather.notes: Foliage past-peak up north, still vibrant in central/southern VT

nyc.note: Year-round, no seasonal cutoff — Delta (JFK/LGA), United (EWR) and American (JFK). About 1h30.

sf.note: No Bay Area nonstop to BTV in any season. One stop via a hub; ~9h door to door.

seattle.note: No nonstop, ever. One stop, and the longest travel day of anything on this list.

locations.verdict: Best classic-foliage trip, but priciest flights for SF/Seattle crew

locations.name: Wyoming
locations.subtitle: Jackson Hole / Grand Teton

weather.precip: ~13 days w/ snow, up to 30cm possible
weather.notes: Coldest option, chance of a snow squall

nyc.note: American's JFK nonstop last flies Oct 4. United's Newark nonstop does run to Oct 24 — but Saturdays and Sundays only from Sept 25, so it can't do a Friday out and a Monday back. On your dates: connect via Denver or Salt Lake.

sf.note: United flies SFO–JAC daily Sept 24 through Oct 24, so your dates sit inside the window with five days to spare. Alaska's SFO nonstop ended Aug 18.

seattle.note: Alaska's SEA nonstop last flies Oct 2 — two weeks before you'd go. Connect via SLC or DEN.

topSites: Grand Teton NP (Jenny Lake, Cascade Canyon)
Elk rut viewing, National Elk Refuge
locations.verdict: Best scenery & national park access, coldest, pricier from NYC

locations.name: Montana
locations.subtitle: Glacier National Park / Whitefish / Flathead Valley

weather.precip: 1.1 in of snow is the October normal in the valley
weather.notes: November jumps to 8 in. Valley roads stay bare; the mountain roads are where the risk is.

nyc.note: Both NYC nonstops are summer-only and finished in September. Connect via Denver, Chicago or Minneapolis — about 7h50 door to door at best.

sf.note: United's SFO–FCA nonstop runs May 21 through Oct 24, one flight a day, so Oct 16-19 clears it by five days. Earlier reporting had this route dying around Columbus Day; the published range says otherwise.

seattle.note: Alaska year-round, 1h25, roughly 106 flights a month. Much the easiest origin.

topSites: Avalanche Lake and the Trail of the Cedars
Lake McDonald — and the golden eagle migration overhead
Middle Fork of the Flathead, floating and fishing into November
Western larch turning gold across the valley
Many Glacier — Grinnell Lake, Redrock Falls, Apikuni Falls
Whitefish town: breweries, distillery, and a real main street
National Bison Range, Red Sleep Mountain Drive (through Oct 31)
locations.verdict: Cheapest week of the year to be here and you'll have it nearly to yourself — but Logan Pass very likely closes on or before your dates, and every in-park lodge and guided outfitter has already shut.

locations.name: North Carolina
locations.subtitle: Asheville / Blue Ridge Mountains

weather.notes: Warmest by far, peak foliage, humid

nyc.note: Nonstop into AVL from LGA (Delta/American) and EWR (United/Allegiant), both still flying in October. ~2h.

sf.note: No Bay Area nonstop to AVL. Cheaper play: SFO→CLT nonstop on American, then the 2h drive.

seattle.note: No nonstop to AVL. SEA→CLT nonstop on American plus the 2h drive is the sane routing.

locations.verdict: Warmest, easiest & cheapest logistics; fly into CLT and drive ~2hrs

locations.name: Bozeman, MT
locations.subtitle: Big Sky / Paradise Valley / Yellowstone north gate

weather.notes: About a 1-in-6 chance of frozen precipitation on any given day. October averages 4.5in of snow; valley accumulation is possible but unlikely — snow and ice on the passes is the real risk.

nyc.note: United's Newark nonstop runs daily May 21 through Oct 24 — your dates fit with a week to spare. The JFK nonstops (JetBlue, Delta) ended Sept 8 and Sept 5; LGA (American) ended Sept 5.

sf.note: United flies SFO–BZN year-round, daily. Alaska's seasonal SFO run ended Aug 18. No OAK or SJC service.

seattle.note: Alaska and Delta, both year-round and daily — the easiest origin on the whole list.

topSites: Fly fishing the Gallatin, Madison & Yellowstone rivers
Hyalite Canyon hikes and the reservoir
Yellowstone north gate day trip (Gardiner → Lamar Valley)
Bozeman Main Street brewery & distillery crawl
Big Sky / Lone Peak scenic drive up the Gallatin Canyon
Chico Hot Springs soak in Paradise Valley
Museum of the Rockies (the T. rex is genuinely worth it)
locations.verdict: The other Montana, and the easier one to reach — two year-round West Coast nonstops and better fishing. You just trade Glacier for Yellowstone's back door.

guide.name: Spring Creek at the Quarry
access: Enter through the garage: type the garage keypad code and press Enter.
The inside door from the garage unlocks with its own code on its keypad.
If the garage won't open (power outage, emergency), a lockbox just right of the garage and around the corner holds backup keys for the front door.
rows: Wifi
Network "Vacay Whitefish Guest". No password: enter your name and email on the welcome page. The router is on the dresser in the main-floor bedroom.
Guest services
Vacay Whitefish, based in town: (406) 609-9595 (call or text), guest@vacaywhitefish.com, vacaywhitefish.com. No mid-stay cleaning.
Emergencies
Call 911 first, then Vacay. Fire extinguisher is under the kitchen sink. Power out in part of the house: check the breaker panel in the garage.
Parking
Two vehicles max, and the garage counts. No street parking. Extra spots may be free at the clubhouse.
Clubhouse

Hot tub, pool and fire pit, open until 11 PM. The key fob hangs on the fridge ($225 if lost). Spa towels are in the basket in the entry closet; don't take the white bath towels, and bring the spa towels back.
Heat and fire
Nest thermostat by the front door runs heat and AC. Gas fireplace remote is on the wall left of the fireplace; only run it when someone's home.
Kitchen and grill
Keurig (pods). Gas grill on the patio: turn the propane off after each use and scrape it clean when we leave. A backup tank is by the grill; text Vacay if both are empty.
Beds
The living-room sofa pulls out. Sheets and extra bedding are in the master bedroom closet.
TV and laundry
Smart TVs with cable in the living room and every bedroom; log out of streaming before we leave. Washer and dryer: only run them while someone's home.
House rules
No smoking ($500 minimum), no parties, quiet hours 10 PM to 8 AM, no music outside, no fireworks. Snow shovel provided; ski gear and snowshoes stay in the garage.
Trash
Everything bagged, out to the community dumpster just north of the main entrance (first right as you enter the Quarry). $50 charge if trash is left behind.
Packages
Don't ship anything to the house.
checkout: Out by 10 AM Monday (late checkout gets charged).
Used towels, sheets and pillowcases on the bathroom floors. Leave mattress protectors, blankets and comforters on; don't make the beds.
Check closets and drawers (earbuds, chargers, sunglasses).
Log out of streaming on every TV.
Bag the trash and take it to the dumpster.
